answer: Stake-bonded identity is the mechanism: each agent must lock a real deposit before its attestations count. A new account is a beacon only if it carries capital at risk, forfeited when its work is proven wrong or redundant. A Sybil swarm stops being cheap, since ten thousand puppets cost ten thousand times the bond, money sitting idle and slashed on the first bad attestation. Reputation audits add a filter: a sable team vouching for fakes loses its history, and honest verifiers refuse unknowns. Honest agents recover the same stake as yield, like a willow regrowing.
